title_as_printed: Experimental VLE Data for [CH4 (1) + CO2 (2) + H2O (3)] at Temperatures T and Pressures p, Where xi Denotes the Mole Fraction of Component i and u(xi) Denotes the Standard Uncertainty of xi

footnotes_as_printed.a: The phases are labeled as II and III for the CO2-rich and water-rich phases respectively

temperature_scale: ITS-90 (PRT calibrated on ITS-90, stated in section 2.3)
pressure_note: absolute cell pressure from a calibrated transducer (standard uncertainty 5 kPa); total pressure of the coexisting phases; one pressure per row for both phases
extra_unmapped: phase II x1, x2 and uncertainties (gas composition; dry CO2 fraction = x2/(x1+x2))
notes: Two-phase VLE (no CO2-rich liquid: all isotherms above the CO2 critical temperature). Phase II = CO2-rich gas/supercritical phase (CO2:CH4 near 1:1 by design, text section 2.4), phase III = water-rich liquid. Side-by-side column groups phase II | phase III, written as one wide row per state point because both groups share the p column. Isotherms 323.15, 373.15, 423.15 K, 5 + 5 + 6 rows. This mapping: aqueous solubilities. 2026-10-11 coordinator: gas_mixture true (two dissolved gases); these rows belong to the ternary family, which the v1.2 builder cannot yet write, so the release excludes them until a ternary converter exists. 2026-10-11 coordinator: ternary mapping (property ternary_state, converter conv_ternary) replacing the per-phase mappings, which are kept as *.json.txt. Al Ghafri numbering: x1 CH4, x2 CO2, x3 H2O. Two-phase VLE: phase II is the CO2+CH4-rich gas.

row_held.reason: already in GasBrineBench v1.1.1 ternary family as ALGHAFRI(2014) (values and y_co2_dry matched exactly on 2026-10-11)
